description: This file contains Alembic migration script for adding foreign key 'created_by_fk' as owner to datasets, slices, and tables in the Superset project, including class definitions for database models and upgrade logic.

classes.name: Dataset
classes.description: Represents the 'sl_datasets' table with 'id' and 'created_by_fk' columns.

classes.name: DatasetUser
classes.description: Represents the 'sl_dataset_users' table with 'id', 'user_id', and 'dataset_id' columns.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents the 'slices' table with 'id' and 'created_by_fk' columns.

classes.name: SliceUser
classes.description: Represents the 'slice_user' table with 'id', 'user_id', and 'slice_id' columns.

classes.name: SqlaTable
classes.description: Represents the 'tables' table with 'id' and 'created_by_fk' columns.

classes.name: SqlaTableUser
classes.description: Represents the 'sqlatable_user' table with 'id', 'user_id', and 'table_id' columns.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs data migration to insert missing owner references into user association tables for datasets, slices, and tables.
